title: Jump And Run For Brainrot
description:
Run and Jump for Brainrot is a fast-paced game where your goal is to collect Brainrot memes and grow stronger.

Jump across platforms to gather Brainrot, bring it back to your base, and power up. Level up to jump higher and reach even more challenging areas.

title: Rough Ball
description: Rough Ball is an addictive and challenging physics-based platformer where you control a cheeky smiley ball on a dangerous journey through rocky caves. Your goal is simple but tricky: roll, bounce, and slide carefully to reach the red flag without falling into the deadly pits. With slippery slopes, tricky jumps, and cute skull warnings, every level tests your precision and timing in this fun "do not fall" adventure!
